module origen_043864 (
    input wire CLK,
    input wire Read_Enable,
    input wire Write_Enable,
    input wire Mode,
    input wire Busy,
    input wire [15:0] Frame_Data,
    output reg [9:0] Row_Data,
    output reg [9:0] Col_Data,
    output reg Read,
    output reg Write,
    output reg Reset,
    output reg Address_Reset,
    output reg Pixel_select
);

    // Initialization
    initial begin
        Row_Data = 10'b0;
        Col_Data = 10'b0;
        Read = 1'b0;
        Write = 1'b0;
        Reset = 1'b0;
        Address_Reset = 1'b0;
        Pixel_select = 1'b0;
    end

    // Read/Write Control
    always @(*) begin
        if (Busy) begin
            Read = 1'b0;
            Write = 1'b0;
        end else if (Read_Enable) begin
            Read = 1'b1;
            Write = 1'b0;
        end else if (Write_Enable) begin
            Write = 1'b1;
            Read = 1'b0;
        end else begin
            Read = 1'b0;
            Write = 1'b0;
        end
    end

    // Address Reset
    always @(posedge CLK) begin
        Address_Reset <= Mode;
    end

    // Note: Row_Data, Col_Data, Pixel_select, Reset, and Frame_Data are not used in this implementation
    // They can be implemented based on specific requirements

endmodule
